messages:
maria: quick heads-up — new int4 build (quant-v2) shows progressive context degradation around ~32k tokens on model-003 (we expect 64k). short repro + logs: http://ci/reports/4251

devon: can you paste the minimal repro and exact runtime flags? :thumbsup:

maria: run: `python tests/longctx_smoke.py --model model-003 --quant int4v2 --tokens 33000 --stream`
observed: fp16 baseline stays coherent, int4v2 diverges after token ~32040. small log excerpt:
```
[32038] kv_hash=0xabc123ef
[32039] kv_hash=0xabc123ef
[32040] kv_hash=0xdeadbeef  <-- first mismatch
[32041] kv_hash=0xdeadbeef
```

ash: interesting — are you using rotary rescale=1.0 (new) or legacy? the int4 packer might be applying a per-shard scale that shifts phase. also, prefix_cache enabled?

maria: rescale=legacy (pre-quant). prefix_cache=on. fwiw, if i disable prefix_cache the divergence shifts later (~48k), so seems like caching+quant interaction.

suzanne: that pattern screams position/phase rounding in the quant path. can you run with `--ropereset` (resets rotary phase accumulation) and dump a tiny kv slice at the failure point? tag @eng-runtime so they see it.

devon: i'll kick off a bisect across quant-packer commits + int4v1 vs int4v2. maria, can you upload a hexdump of the kv at 32040 (just first 256 bytes)? quick hexdump helps isolate packer drift.

maria: uploaded /tmp/kv-dump-4251.bin to the artifact store. snippet: ```hex
0000: ab cd ef 12 34 56 78 90
0010: 11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88
0020: aa bb cc dd ee ff 00 11
```

ops-bot: ci-runner: scheduled job #7894 to run longctx-bisect on qc-build:4251 (ETA ~18m).

ben: can repro locally on an 80GB A100 with docker image qc-build:4251. nvprof shows a different kernel path after quant pack, fused-rope kernel used only in quant path. i'll try disabling fused-rope-kernel and re-run.

suzanne: if fused-rope is the culprit we should add a runtime guard to fallback to software rope when quant flag is present, but document perf regression. please open an RFC/ops ticket with perf numbers.

ash: short mitigation for rollout: set `runtime.ropereset=true` and `runtime.prefix_cache=false` for the current canary until bisect finishes. maria — can you smoke that config?

maria: starting smoke with those flags now, will post results in ~10m. thanks everyone.
